mail.yandexInstructions:
Yandex:
1) Open Yandex ID → Security.
2) Create an app password for mail.
3) Run: /mail_setup yandex <email> <app_password>.
mail.googleInstructions:
Google:
1) Enable 2FA for your account.
2) Create an App Password for Mail.
3) Run: /mail_setup google <email> <app_password>.
